forCreators.heroHeading: Your expertise deserves a platform built for depth.
forCreators.heroBody: AlphaGlow AI is where creators and experts build sustainable income — not by chasing followers, but by earning NSVX from users who complete their programs.
forCreators.novaBody: Nova acts as your on-platform representative — delivering your programs to the right user at the right time, without you lifting a finger.
forCreators.economyTitle: A token economy that pays you
forCreators.economyBody: Every NSVX spent inside your program flows back to you. No race to the bottom, no algorithm fighting for attention — depth beats volume.
forCreators.dtBody: License your expertise as a Digital Twin — an AI-powered interactive version of your program that runs 24/7 and scales without you.
forCreators.dataBody: See completion rates, NSVX flows, and user signals. Know what works before your next program, not after.
forCreators.discoveryBody: Nova recommends your programs based on user profiles — not follower counts. Quality content surfaces without ads.
forCreators.soundBody: Upload your signature sounds, music, or ambient tracks. They become part of your brand on the platform.
forCreators.step1Body: Tell us about your expertise and your audience. Nova reviews your application and you hear back in minutes.
forCreators.step2Body: Use Creator Hub to design sessions, upload content, and set your NSVX pricing.
forCreators.step3Body: Nova personalizes and schedules your program for each user based on their goals and signals.
forCreators.step4Body: Every session completed, every NSVX spent in your program — tracked and paid in real time as you earn.
forCreators.ctaHeading: Ready to bring your program here?
forCreators.ctaBody: Applications are reviewed individually. We partner with creators who are serious about user outcomes — not content volume.
forCreators.payoutHeading: 85% of NSVX flows back to you
forCreators.payoutBody: When a user spends NSVX in your program — unlocking a session, accessing your Digital Twin, licensing your music — 85% of that value returns to you directly. AlphaGlow AI keeps 15% to fund the platform and the reward pool. No middlemen. No platform cuts on top of cuts.
forCreators.payoutStat: of all NSVX spent in your program returns directly to you
forCreators.dtCreatorBody: A Digital Twin is an AI-powered interactive version of you — trained on your content, delivered in your voice, available to your audience 24 hours a day. Users can ask it questions, work through challenges, and receive guidance that sounds and thinks like you. Your Digital Twin is built in Creator Hub. It earns NSVX while you sleep.
forCreators.novaStudioBody: Nova learns each user's goals, patterns, and responses. She recommends your program to the users most likely to benefit — and schedules your sessions for the moments when they are most likely to engage. You build the program once. Nova does the delivery, the timing, and the matching.
forCreators.yogaDesc: Full-length flows, breathwork, and anatomy cues — built as a structured program, not a scroll of clips.
forCreators.trainerDesc: Progressive strength plans, mobility routines, and daily check-ins — all tracked and adapted by Nova.
forCreators.musicianDesc: Original soundscapes, frequency-based listening sessions, and music programs for focus, calm, and sleep.
forCreators.podcasterDesc: Deep-dive audio sessions, interview formats, and educational series — distributed as structured creator programs.
forCreators.nutritionistDesc: Evidence-based food protocols, personalized plans, and accountability — built for real outcomes, not viral clips.
forCreators.meditationGuideDesc: Deep stillness practices — sleep, focus, and emotional regulation — delivered as a structured journey.
forCreators.example1Body: Maya builds a 6-week hip-opening journey and sets her own price in NSVX. Users can talk to Maya's Digital Twin any time, in her actual voice, and it recommends the right session or journey from her library based on what they're working through. Maya could charge per session, price the journey as one package, or make it free and grow her audience through ads instead, it's entirely her call.
forCreators.example2Body: Jordan builds a 12-week strength program as a journey, plus standalone sessions for quick workouts. Users talk to Jordan's Digital Twin about what they're training for, and it points them to the right session or the full journey from his library. Jordan sets his own NSVX price on each, or offers some free and monetizes through ads instead.
forCreators.example3Body: Elena writes ambient and instrumental tracks, some she publishes as full soundscape sessions for listeners, others she uploads to the Music Marketplace as background tracks for other creators to license into their own sessions, a yoga teacher needing a calm backdrop, a podcaster wanting a theme bed. She sets her own NSVX price on each track and each session, or offers some free and builds her audience through ads. Every time another creator licenses one of her tracks into their session, Elena earns her share automatically.
forCreators.example4Body: Marcus publishes deep-dive episodes as standalone sessions and groups related ones into themed journeys. His Digital Twin talks with listeners about what they're curious about and points them to the right episode or journey. Marcus sets his own NSVX price per episode or per journey, or runs some free with ad support.
forCreators.example5Body: Priya builds individual protocol sessions and a full multi-week journey for sustainable habit change. Users describe their goals to her Digital Twin, and it recommends the right session or the full journey from her library. She prices each however she wants, or offers an entry journey free and monetizes through ads.
forCreators.example6Body: Sam publishes standalone meditation sessions and a multi-week stillness journey. Talking to Sam's Digital Twin about what someone's dealing with gets them pointed to the right session or the journey itself. Sam sets NSVX pricing per session or per journey, or offers some free and builds an audience through ads.
forCreators.openInviteBody: This is just six examples. Whatever your expertise is, if it can become a program, Nova can deliver it. Apply now and set your own price.

forListeners.heroHeading: Guidance that actually knows where you are.
forListeners.heroBody: Stop starting over. AlphaGlow AI connects you with expert-designed programs, delivered by Nova — your AI guide that remembers everything and adapts as you grow.
forListeners.step1Body: Your goals, habits, sleep, stress level. Nova builds a picture of where you are and where you want to go.
forListeners.step2Body: Nova recommends the right programs from real creators and experts — not ads, not follower counts.
forListeners.step3Body: Complete sessions, hit streaks, and hit milestones. Every step forward earns tokens you can spend or hold.
forListeners.step4Body: Nova learns from every check-in. Programs adapt to your progress. Results deepen over time.
forListeners.memoryBody: Nova tracks your history, your mood, your milestones. Every conversation builds on the last.
forListeners.expertsBody: Every creator on AlphaGlow AI is vetted. You get specialist depth, not generalist platitudes.
forListeners.nsvxBody: Earn tokens for consistency and completion — then spend them on premium content or creator sessions.
forListeners.noNoiseBody: No endless feed. Nova surfaces what you need when you need it. The platform is quiet by design.
forListeners.modalitiesBody: Meditation, breathwork, movement, nutrition, sleep, sound healing — all coordinated by Nova around your life.
forListeners.offlineBody: Download sessions for use anywhere. Your practice doesn't stop when the wifi does.
forListeners.ctaBody: Your first 30 days are free. No credit card required.

howNsvx.heroHeading: Progress that earns. Depth that pays.
howNsvx.heroBody: NSVX is the AlphaGlow AI utility token. Watch ads to full completion, catch limited-time promotions, and invite friends. The platform rewards real, verified attention — not the scroll.
howNsvx.earnAdCompletion: Watch an ad to full completion (opt-in)
howNsvx.spendDisclaimer: Token amounts are indicative and subject to change. See the {nsvxLink} for full details.
howNsvx.creatorFlowHeading: For creators: NSVX flows back to you.
howNsvx.creatorFlowBody: Every NSVX spent inside your creator program is split: a portion to the user's session, a portion to AlphaGlow AI platform operations, and the majority back to you — the creator. Transparent, automatic, weekly.
howNsvx.faq1A: Yes. NSVX is a real, transferable token on the Solana blockchain. It is not yet listed on a public exchange, but AlphaGlow AI is working toward exchange listings.
howNsvx.faq2Q: Can I sell or transfer NSVX?
howNsvx.faq2A: Yes. NSVX is a transferable Solana token — you can withdraw it to your own Solana wallet. It is not yet directly convertible to fiat currency within the platform.
howNsvx.faq3A: A portion of every NSVX spent inside a creator's program flows back to that creator — automatically, weekly. The exact split is disclosed in the Creator Agreement.
howNsvx.faq4A: Tokens earned through normal activity do not expire. Promotional tokens may carry expiry dates, which are disclosed at the time of award.
howNsvx.faq5Q: Where can I see my NSVX balance?
howNsvx.faq5A: Your balance is visible in the AlphaGlow AI app dashboard, updated in real time after each session.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy

We are committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains what personal information we collect, how we use it, who we share it with, and your rights regarding that information.

privacy.s2i2: Profile information: language preference, personal goals, and Nova AI settings
privacy.s2i3: Session activity: completion records, streaks, and check-in responses
privacy.s2i4: Nova AI conversation history, used to personalize your experience
privacy.s2i5: Solana wallet address associated with your NSVX token account, provisioned via AlphaGlow AI's own AWS/KMS wallet infrastructure
privacy.s2intro2: We collect information automatically when you use the Platform:
privacy.s2i6: Device type, operating system version, and browser or app information
privacy.s2i7: Session timestamps, feature usage patterns, and interaction logs
privacy.s2i8: NSVX token transaction records on the Solana blockchain
privacy.s2i9: Push notification registration tokens (only when you opt in)
privacy.s3i1: To operate, maintain, and improve the AlphaGlow AI Platform
privacy.s3i2: To power Nova AI personalization, including memory continuity and coaching responses
privacy.s3i3: To calculate and distribute NSVX token rewards for session completions and community activity
privacy.s3i4: To provide creator analytics, including session performance and audience engagement data for creators
privacy.s3i5: To send session reminders and session notifications (only with your explicit consent)
privacy.s3i6: To process payments, creator revenue distributions, and NSVX token purchases
privacy.s3i7: To comply with applicable legal obligations and enforce our Terms of Service
privacy.s4p: Your conversations with Nova are stored to provide memory continuity, personalized coaching, and behavioral insights. We do not sell this data to third parties. Conversation data may be used in aggregate, anonymized form to improve AI model quality. You may request deletion of your Nova conversation history at any time.
privacy.s5intro: We work with the following third-party service providers, each of whom processes data as necessary to deliver their services:
privacy.s5i1: Supabase — provides our authentication system and primary database infrastructure. Data is stored under Standard Contractual Clauses.
privacy.s5i2: AWS Key Management Service (KMS) — AlphaGlow AI's own wallet infrastructure provisions and manages your Solana wallet for NSVX token storage, with private keys encrypted via AWS KMS.
privacy.s5i3: Cartesia — provides AI voice synthesis for Creator Digital Twin sessions. Audio generation requests are processed per Cartesia's privacy terms.
privacy.s5i4: Transak — enables fiat-to-NSVX token purchases. Transak is an independent regulated payment processor subject to its own KYC/AML obligations.
privacy.s5i5: Solana Blockchain — NSVX token transactions are recorded on the Solana public blockchain. Blockchain data is publicly visible and cannot be deleted.
privacy.s5i6: Anthropic — processes Nova AI conversation data to generate responses, per Anthropic API terms.
privacy.s5p: We do not sell your personal data to advertisers or data brokers.
privacy.s6p: We retain account and profile data for the duration of your active account plus 90 days following deletion. Nova AI conversation history is retained for 24 months and can be deleted on written request. NSVX transaction records and financial logs are retained for 7 years for regulatory compliance. Blockchain transaction records on Solana are permanent and cannot be removed.
privacy.s7intro: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the right to:
privacy.s7i1: Access a copy of the personal data we hold about you
privacy.s7i2: Correct inaccurate or incomplete personal data
privacy.s7i3: Request deletion of your account and associated personal data
privacy.s7i4: Opt out of non-essential communications and marketing
privacy.s7i5: Lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority (EU/EEA and UK users)
privacy.s7p: To exercise any of these rights, email us at admin@alphaglowai.com with the subject line "Privacy Request." We will respond within 30 days.
privacy.s8p: We use essential cookies and browser storage (localStorage, IndexedDB) for authentication, session management, and offline functionality. We do not use advertising cookies or third-party behavioral tracking. We do not use Google Analytics or similar surveillance-based analytics tools.
privacy.s9p: AlphaGlow AI is not directed to children under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from anyone under 13. If you believe a child under 13 has created an account, contact us immediately at admin@alphaglowai.com and we will delete the account and associated data.
privacy.s10p: Push notifications are entirely opt-in. Your device push token is stored solely for the purpose of delivering session reminders you have requested. You can revoke push notification permission at any time through your device settings.
privacy.s11p: We will notify you of material changes to this Privacy Policy via in-app notification or email at least 14 days before they take effect. Continued use of the Platform after that date constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
privacy.s12p: Privacy inquiries: admin@alphaglowai.com. NeuroScope Technologies LLC, 4055 Westminster Dr, Sarasota, Florida 34241.

aiDisc.title: AI Disclaimer
aiDisc.s1p1: Nova, the AlphaGlow AI, is powered by large language models (LLMs) provided by Anthropic (Claude). Nova's responses are generated algorithmically based on your inputs, your profile data, and the system context configured by AlphaGlow AI.
aiDisc.s1p2: AI-generated content is probabilistic in nature. Nova may produce responses that are incomplete, imprecise, outdated, or contextually inappropriate. AlphaGlow AI does not guarantee the accuracy, reliability, or completeness of any content produced by Nova.
aiDisc.s2h: 2. Not a Substitute for Professional Advice
aiDisc.s2p1: Nova is designed to be a supportive AI guide — not a licensed professional. Nothing Nova says constitutes medical advice, psychological treatment, dietary prescription, or any other form of regulated professional advice.
aiDisc.s2p2: You should always consult qualified professionals (physicians, therapists, registered dietitians, etc.) before making changes to your health regimen, medication, or mental health treatment plan. See our Health Disclaimer for further details.
aiDisc.s3p: Nova retains conversation history to provide continuity and personalization. This memory is stored securely in our database and used solely to improve your experience on the Platform. Nova does not have access to external databases, the internet, or real-time information unless explicitly stated.
aiDisc.s4p: The AI models powering Nova have knowledge cutoff dates and may not reflect the most recent research, guidelines, or events. Nova may occasionally produce "hallucinations" — plausible-sounding but factually incorrect information. We actively work to mitigate this through system prompt design and output review, but we cannot eliminate it entirely.
aiDisc.s5p: Digital Twin sessions are AI-generated experiences modeled on creator-provided scripts, personas, and guidance frameworks. They are not live interactions with the creator. The creator has reviewed and approved the framework for their Digital Twin, but individual AI-generated responses within sessions are not pre-screened by the creator.
aiDisc.s6p: Nova is not equipped to handle mental health emergencies. If you are experiencing a mental health crisis, suicidal thoughts, or a medical emergency, please contact emergency services (911 in the US), the 988 Suicide and Crisis Lifeline, or your local emergency services immediately. Nova will remind you of these resources when crisis signals are detected, but this is not a substitute for real help.
aiDisc.s7p: Anonymized, aggregated conversation patterns may be used internally to improve system prompt quality and AI behavior. Individual conversations are not shared with Anthropic for model training without explicit consent, in accordance with Anthropic's API terms.
aiDisc.s8p: Questions about our AI systems: ai@alphaglowai.app.

healthDisc.title: Health Disclaimer
healthDisc.s1p: The content on AlphaGlow AI — including sessions, programs, creator content, Nova AI responses, soundscapes, and any other material on the Platform — is provided for general informational and informational purposes only. It does not constitute, and should not be treated as, medical advice, diagnosis, treatment, or a medical recommendation of any kind.
healthDisc.s2p1: Before beginning any new practice, exercise program, dietary change, breathing technique, meditation practice, or other health-related activity introduced through this Platform, you should consult a qualified healthcare provider who is familiar with your individual health situation.
healthDisc.s2p2: This is especially important if you have or suspect you may have any physical or mental health condition, take prescription medication, are pregnant, or have recently undergone surgery or medical treatment.
healthDisc.s3p: Use of AlphaGlow AI does not create a doctor-patient, therapist-client, or any other professional care relationship between you and AlphaGlow AI, Nova, or any creator on the Platform — regardless of whether a creator holds professional credentials.
healthDisc.s4p1: AlphaGlow AI offers personal growth tools that may be beneficial for stress management, mindfulness, and general emotional balance. These tools are not a substitute for professional mental health treatment, therapy, counseling, or psychiatric care.
healthDisc.s4p2: If you are experiencing symptoms of depression, anxiety, trauma, or any other mental health condition that significantly affects your daily functioning, please seek help from a licensed mental health professional.
healthDisc.s5p1: If you or someone you know is in immediate danger or experiencing a medical or mental health emergency, call your local emergency number (911 in the US) immediately. For mental health crises, the 988 Suicide and Crisis Lifeline is available 24/7 by call or text.
healthDisc.s5p2: AlphaGlow AI is not equipped to respond to emergencies.
healthDisc.s6p: Outcomes vary significantly between individuals. Any testimonials, results, or success stories shared on the Platform represent individual experiences and are not typical results. AlphaGlow AI makes no guarantees regarding specific health or outcomes from using the Platform.
healthDisc.s7p: Some creator programs may include physical movement, breathwork, or other activities that carry inherent physical risk. Participate within your physical limits. Stop immediately and seek medical attention if you experience pain, dizziness, shortness of breath, or any other concerning symptoms.
healthDisc.s8p: AlphaGlow AI reviews creator applications, but does not verify, validate, or guarantee the credentials, licenses, or qualifications of any creator. Creator-provided content reflects the individual creator's approach and expertise and has not been reviewed or approved by AlphaGlow AI's medical or clinical advisors.

advertisers.heroHeading: Reach the most focused audience on the internet.
advertisers.heroBody: AlphaGlow AI users are mid-session — breathing, moving, reflecting. Nova Whisper delivers your message in the moments that matter, with full user consent and verifiable attention.
advertisers.whisperBody: Nova Whisper is AlphaGlow AI's privacy-first advertising layer. Instead of interrupting users with banner ads, Nova surfaces brand messages in contextually appropriate moments — when a user completes a session, opens the Pulse feed, or asks Nova for a recommendation. Every impression is user-consented and attention-verified.
advertisers.whisperStat: Average verified completion rate: 100%. Payout only ever triggers on a fully verified completion — which means anything counted is genuine, full attention.
advertisers.adClassesHeading: Three ways to reach your audience
advertisers.preSessDesc: A brief brand message shown before a session begins. Users opt in to ads in exchange for NSVX rewards. Completion is tracked and verified.
advertisers.whisperDesc: Nova delivers a short, voiced brand message to users who have opted in to notifications. Contextually timed — never during a session, never during distress moments.
advertisers.pulseDesc: Sponsored posts in the AlphaGlow AI Pulse social feed. Indistinguishable in format from creator content — clearly labelled as sponsored.
advertisers.localBody: Target users within a radius of your location. A yoga studio in Berlin. A supplement brand at a conference. Nova Local matches your campaign to users within the distance you set — no third-party cookies, just GPS consent.
advertisers.attentionHeading: You pay for completions, not impressions
advertisers.attentionBody: AlphaGlow AI tracks verified completion — not impressions, not reach. You pay only when a user watches, listens, or engages with your message to the end. Completion rates run at 100% by design, because payout only ever triggers on a fully verified completion.
advertisers.pricingBody: All campaigns are priced on a cost-per-completion basis. No minimum spend for self-serve. Enterprise campaigns include dedicated account management.
advertisers.selfServeDesc: Launch a campaign in minutes. Set your budget, target by category or location, and pay per completion. Minimum budget $100.
advertisers.managedDesc: Dedicated account manager, creative review, and weekly reporting. Starting from $2,500 per month.
advertisers.enterpriseDesc: Custom creative, audience segments, multi-market deployment, and co-marketing options. Contact sales.
advertisers.faq1A: Users explicitly opt in to ads on each surface — sessions, notifications, and Pulse independently. They can withdraw consent at any time. AlphaGlow AI never shows ads to users who have not opted in.
advertisers.faq2Q: What is a completion and how is it verified?
advertisers.faq2A: A completion is a full watch-through of a pre-session ad, a full listen of a Nova Whisper notification, or a Pulse interaction of at least 5 seconds. Completions are tracked in real time and reported in your dashboard.
advertisers.faq3Q: Can I target by creator category?
advertisers.faq3A: Yes. You can target by creator category and by location radius. Sensitive categories — mental health, grief, anxiety — are excluded from ad delivery by platform policy.
advertisers.contactBody: Tell us about your brand and campaign goals. Our team responds within one business day.
advertisers.formSuccess: Thank you. We will be in touch within one business day.

investors.heroHeading: A creator economy that doesn't need a billion users to work
investors.heroBody: AlphaGlow AI is built on a structural advantage most platforms don't have, an economic model where profitability doesn't depend on massive scale, it depends on the right mechanics.
investors.differentBody: Most platforms need hundreds of millions of users before the unit economics make sense. AlphaGlow AI doesn't. Because advertising revenue carries near-zero marginal cost per impression while creator and marketplace fees stay lean and competitive, the model turns profitable at a fraction of the user base a traditional platform requires. At 10,000 active users, the model projects roughly 94,000 dollars a month in combined advertising and token activity. At 100,000 users, that becomes roughly 939,000 a month. This isn't a hope, it's the structure.
investors.novaBody: Nova is the intelligence layer running through every part of AlphaGlow AI. She isn't a chatbot and she isn't generic. Nova learns each user's goals, checks in with them, asks questions, and gets to know how they actually respond over time, then gently guides them toward what they're working on, a nudge here, a well-timed reminder there, always in service of their progress, never to maximize time spent in the app. The longer someone uses AlphaGlow AI, the better Nova gets at knowing them. This is the same intelligence layer that makes everything else on this page possible, the reason ad matching can be relevant instead of generic, the reason local nudges land at the right moment, and the reason engagement here looks fundamentally different from a typical feed.
investors.whisperHeading: Nova Whisper: The First Ads Users Actually Want
investors.whisperBody: Every other platform treats advertising as something users tolerate, skip, or block. AlphaGlow AI inverts that. Nova already understands what a user genuinely cares about, so someone interested in cars sees car-relevant messages, not irrelevant noise, all without ever exposing personal Nova conversations to advertisers, matching happens by category and preference only. Users also control how much advertising they're exposed to, and when they opt in, they're paid in NSVX for their attention, a real revenue share, not a gimmick. This is the first platform where watching an ad is something users look forward to rather than endure, and because payout only ever triggers on a fully verified completion, completion runs at 100 percent for anything counted.
investors.localHeading: Nova Local: The Market Nobody Else Serves
investors.localBody: Local businesses, gyms, restaurants, studios, shops, are largely locked out of modern advertising. Platforms like Meta and Google are built for national budgets and self-serve complexity that assumes marketing expertise most small business owners simply don't have. Nova Local changes that. A business sets a radius, and Nova naturally nudges relevant nearby users toward it in context, someone finishing a workout gets pointed toward a nearby healthy restaurant, not interrupted by a banner ad. No dashboard to learn, no minimum ad spend built for enterprise budgets, just relevant, local, in-the-moment reach.
investors.privacyCommerceHeading: Privacy Commerce: The Marketplace Nobody Else Can Build
investors.privacyCommerceBody: Every other platform's advertising model runs on the same trade, you get relevant ads, they get your data. AlphaGlow AI is building something no competitor can copy without abandoning their own business model, a physical goods marketplace where brands get real storefronts and users buy with NSVX, but the brand never learns who the customer actually is. AlphaGlow AI sits in the middle as an encrypted address vault, orders ship through contracted carriers using a fulfillment code only, the brand never receives a name or address, the carrier only receives the real delivery address at the moment a label is generated. A real product arrives at a real customer's door, and the brand still never sees who bought it. That safety changes the relationship itself, when users know a brand can never trace, target, or exploit their data, they buy with confidence instead of hesitation, and confidence is what brings them back for repeat business. This becomes a fourth demand driver for NSVX alongside sessions, advertising, and the creator marketplace, and a new commerce revenue stream on top of everything else. Where every competitor sells your data, AlphaGlow AI is built to never touch it, and that trust is exactly what turns a one-time buyer into a returning customer.
investors.privacyCommerceNote: Planned for 2027 — not a live capability today.
investors.attentionHeading: Proof of Attention: Advertisers Pay for What Actually Happened
investors.attentionBody: AlphaGlow AI doesn't sell impressions. It sells verified attention. Users opt in, watch, and are rewarded, advertisers only pay for completions, not exposure. Verified completion runs at 100 percent, because payout is only ever triggered by a fully completed view. Every payment settles on Solana, giving advertisers a blockchain transaction hash to independently verify their own spend, not just a number reported back by the platform serving the ad.
investors.currencyBody: NSVX is the single utility token that powers the entire platform, used by users, creators, and advertisers alike to access content, features, and reach. It exists purely as a means of transacting within AlphaGlow AI's economy, not as an investment instrument, and its value comes from real utility and platform activity, not speculation. Every participant in the ecosystem transacts in the same currency, which means every dollar of activity, from a user unlocking a session to an advertiser reaching an audience, moves through and strengthens the same economy.
investors.voteHeading: Proof of Vote: Results Nobody Can Fake
investors.voteBody: AlphaGlow AI's community competitions run on Proof of Vote, every vote costs NSVX, every vote is a public Solana transaction, and every result is independently verifiable by anyone, on-chain, permanently. Community trust isn't a claim here, it's mathematically enforced.
investors.patentBody: AlphaGlow AI's core technology is patent pending, covering two genuinely novel mechanics, real-time, bidirectional AI-translated conversations delivered in a creator's own cloned voice, and fully autonomous Digital Twin sessions that let a creator's methodology scale globally, in any language, without the creator present. This isn't incremental, it's foundational technology built specifically for this platform.
investors.governanceBody: AlphaGlow AI is structuring itself for the long term, not just fast growth. As the company scales, AlphaGlow AI intends to establish a Governing Council, an independent body of experienced professionals, executives, and industry leaders across technology, brand strategy, ethics, and regulatory compliance, brought in specifically for the wealth of real-world judgment they carry. This isn't a symbolic board, it's a deliberate structure designed to bring outside expertise and accountability into how AlphaGlow AI makes decisions as it grows, giving investors, creators, and users confidence that this company is being built to last, not just built fast.
investors.feeHeading: A Fee Structure Built to Last
investors.feeBody: AlphaGlow AI takes a flat, disclosed platform fee, competitive with or better than the platforms creators already know, Patreon at 8 to 12 percent, Substack at 10, OnlyFans at 20, app stores at 30. Advertising, not creator fees, is the platform's real profit engine, which means AlphaGlow AI is structurally aligned with creators succeeding, not squeezing them.
investors.builtBody: AlphaGlow AI didn't start as a pitch deck. February through April 2025, the foundation was mapped, extensive research across every part of the business, the economics, the technology, the market. Summer 2025, the legal and business structure was formalized, a corporation established, trademarks and a provisional patent filed, domains secured. Fall 2025, real platform development began. Today, AlphaGlow AI represents more than 5,000 hours of delivered work, built with care before ever being shown to an investor.
investors.roadmap1Body: Live today. Already live on Android via Google Play; iOS pending Apple review. Creator onboarding, Nova AI, and the NSVX token system are all active.
investors.roadmap2Body: Native-language session narration live across 10 languages. Digital Twin voice-and-text rollout for creators.
investors.roadmap3Body: Advertiser platform live. Transak integration for NSVX purchase, withdrawal to Solana wallet, and cross-platform NSVX spend.
investors.roadmap4Body: Community becomes competitive. Every creator studio gains a Village, where members grow together and compete seasonally in the AG Games with every vote cast in NSVX and permanently verifiable on-chain. Brands can sponsor Villages directly during championship season, offering products or rewards to the communities they want to be part of, turning brand visibility into genuine community goodwill rather than another ad impression. This is the year AlphaGlow AI becomes more than a platform people use, it becomes an economy people trust. Each season runs eight weeks of qualifying followed by two weeks of championship voting, four seasons a year. Villages compete within their own category first, then category champions face off in a Grand Championship. Scoring is based on real participation, growth, and transformation metrics pulled directly from the platform, nothing self-reported. During championship voting, every vote costs 1 NSVX and is cast as a public Solana blockchain transaction, independently verifiable by anyone. AlphaGlow AI takes nothing from the prize pool, 100% goes to the winning Villages and their members. Also being explored for this timeframe, not yet committed or built: live, real-time bidirectional translation streaming for Digital Twin conversations.
investors.contactBody: We are in active conversations with strategic investors. If you are building in the AI or creator economy space and see what we are building — reach out.

novaPage.heroHeading: Your AI guide for the long game.
novaPage.heroBody: Nova is not a chatbot. She is the intelligence layer of AlphaGlow AI — learning your patterns, connecting you with the right creators, and growing with you over time.
novaPage.whatBody: Nova is an AI guide built specifically for personal growth. She is powered by Claude, trained on behavioural science, and shaped by the creators on AlphaGlow AI. She exists to serve your growth — not to keep you on the platform longer.
novaPage.whatCallout: Nova is built on Anthropic's Claude — the same model trusted by enterprises for safe, honest AI. Her goal is your growth, not your engagement.
novaPage.how1Body: Every conversation, check-in, and session outcome is context for Nova. She builds a living model of where you are, what you need, and how you respond.
novaPage.how2Body: Based on your profile, Nova surfaces creator programs that match your goals — not based on popularity or payment. The match is made on compatibility, not commerce.
novaPage.how3Body: If you are struggling, she notices. If you are ready for more, she will challenge you. Nova's job is to keep you moving — not to repeat the same session indefinitely.
novaPage.learnsBody: Nova builds her understanding from what you share with her, session data, and the patterns she observes. Here is what she tracks, and why.
novaPage.learns1Body: So she can match you with programs that are actually relevant, not just popular.
novaPage.learns2Body: So she can adapt her recommendations to how you are doing right now.
novaPage.learns3Body: So she knows what works for you and what does not.
novaPage.learns4Body: So she knows when to push, when to back off, and when to check in.
novaPage.learns5Body: Every rating and comment teaches her to serve you better.
novaPage.privacy1Body: Nova's knowledge of you is used only to serve you. We do not sell, share, or license your personal data to advertisers or third parties.
novaPage.privacy2Body: Every signal Nova holds about you is visible in your account dashboard. No hidden profiles. No opaque scoring.
novaPage.privacy3Body: Delete your Nova memory at any time, in full or selectively. Your account, your data.
novaPage.privacy4Title: Ads never use your Nova data
novaPage.privacy4Body: Ad matching is done by category and location preference only — never by your Nova conversation history or personal profile.
novaPage.dashboardHeading: See what Nova knows about you
novaPage.dashboardBody: Your full Nova profile is visible in your account. Goals, signals, session history, engagement patterns — all there.
novaPage.disclaimerHeading: Nova is an AI guide, not a clinician
novaPage.disclaimerBody: Nova is an AI tool for personal growth and growth motivation. She is not a therapist, doctor, or licensed health professional. Nothing she says constitutes medical or psychological advice. If you are in crisis, please contact a mental health professional or emergency services.
novaPage.ctaBody: Available inside the AlphaGlow AI app. Free to start.

nsvxPage.heroHeading: The token economy powering AlphaGlow AI.
nsvxPage.heroBody: NSVX is the utility token that rewards consistent practice. Earn it through activity, spend it on content and depth.
nsvxPage.whatBody: NSVX is a Solana-based utility token that powers the AlphaGlow AI creator economy. It is not speculative. It is not a financial instrument. It is the unit of value that aligns creators and users in a shared economy — the more you engage, the more the economy grows, and the more you benefit from it.
nsvxPage.solanaBody: NSVX runs on Solana — sub-second settlement, near-zero transaction fees, and the most active developer ecosystem in Web3. Every NSVX transaction settles in under a second at a fraction of a cent.
nsvxPage.earn6Body: Users who opt in to Nova Whisper ads earn bonus NSVX for every verified completion.
nsvxPage.buyBody: Purchase NSVX directly through AlphaGlow AI via Transak. Solana-native, non-custodial, and available in most countries.
nsvxPage.buyNote: The Transak widget will appear here when NSVX is available to purchase. Register your interest to be notified first.
nsvxPage.buyNotifySuccess: You are on the list. We will reach out when NSVX is available to purchase.
nsvxPage.spend1Body: Access paid creator programs, exclusive soundscapes, and advanced journeys.
nsvxPage.spend2Body: Spend NSVX to unlock access to a creator's Digital Twin for a session or month.
nsvxPage.withdrawBody: When you are ready, withdraw your NSVX to any Solana-compatible wallet. Minimum withdrawal: 100 NSVX. Withdrawals process within 24 hours.
nsvxPage.economicsBody: NSVX is designed for sustainability — not speculation. The reward pool is calibrated to the platform's engagement, and creator payouts are funded by user NSVX spending. The economy grows as the community grows.
nsvxPage.faq1A: Yes. NSVX is a real token, live on the Solana blockchain today — not an internal points system or a future promise. It's not yet listed on a public exchange, though AlphaGlow AI is actively working toward exchange listings. It's a utility token designed for use within the AlphaGlow AI platform, not as a speculative investment, and should not be purchased with money you cannot afford to spend on platform content.
nsvxPage.faq2Q: Can I cash out my NSVX?
nsvxPage.faq2A: Yes. Withdrawal to a Solana wallet works today — 100 NSVX minimum, processed within 24 hours. AlphaGlow AI does not facilitate direct NSVX-to-fiat conversion within the platform; what you do with your NSVX after withdrawal is your own responsibility.
nsvxPage.faq3A: A full technical whitepaper is in preparation. Register on the Investors page to receive it when published.
nsvxPage.faq4Q: How is the NSVX reward pool funded?
nsvxPage.faq4A: The reward pool is funded by platform revenue — subscription fees, creator program fees, and advertiser spend. A fixed percentage of platform revenue is allocated to user and creator NSVX rewards each quarter.
nsvxPage.faq5Q: What happens to NSVX if I delete my account?
nsvxPage.faq5A: NSVX held in your platform wallet will be forfeited after a 30-day grace period if you do not withdraw it first. NSVX already in your Solana wallet is yours and unaffected.
nsvxPage.legalNote: NSVX is a utility token, not a financial instrument. It carries no guarantee of value and should not be treated as an investment.

ambassador.approvalRequired: Application and approval required — we review every applicant individually.
ambassador.categoriesBody: Each referral type has its own structure. Creator and advertiser referrals earn 10% of the gross revenue the referred party generates through AlphaGlow AI, paid to you as an NSVX equivalent of that dollar value, for twelve months from the date of the referral.
ambassador.creatorBody: Introduce a creator who completes onboarding and publishes their first content. You earn 10% of the gross revenue they generate through AlphaGlow AI — paid to you as an NSVX equivalent — for 12 months starting from the date of the referral.
ambassador.advertiserBody: Introduce a brand or advertiser who runs a campaign on AlphaGlow AI. You earn 10% of the gross ad spend they generate through AlphaGlow AI — paid to you as an NSVX equivalent — for 12 months starting from the date of the referral.

ambassador.clarityBody1: Your 10% ambassador commission is calculated directly on the gross revenue the creator or advertiser generates through AlphaGlow AI — not on a smaller platform fee. It's paid to you as an NSVX equivalent of that dollar amount, for the twelve months following the date of the referral.
ambassador.clarityBody2: Example: if a creator you referred earns $200 through AlphaGlow AI in a given month, your commission for that month is 10% of that amount — $20, paid to you as an NSVX equivalent. This applies for twelve months from the date of the referral, then ends.
